requires a signed release

observations.why: Establishing a mandatory gate before deployment appeals to security and stability (conservation) and to disciplined craft (competence).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Citing past security failures as the justification for a gate appeals to conservation — preventing recurrence, protecting the pipeline.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Restating the gate as a formal rule reinforces security and stability (conservation) and procedural rigor (competence).
Extending the gate's scope across environments appeals to conservation — uniform security coverage, no gaps.
Naming oneself as owner of the gate appeals to achievement and standing (self-enhancement) and to mastery over the process (competence).
